beats.text: That isn't much of a compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then admire how hard I'm working to make it one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful promotion. Your timing with the director's retirement was beautiful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I worked for this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how considerate of the vacancy to arrive when you were ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you just be happy?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm choosing the most generous version available this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder if helping earns me first choice of barbecue food.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favour?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. What does the favour redeem for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Friendship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Is friendship available before the sausages run out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If I apologise first, what do I win?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: An end to this argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's not a game.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is going first carrying all the risk?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fair race gives me a head start. I've had a tiring morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So has everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then compensate us proportionally. Mine involved stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We start on the same line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Move my portion of the line forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll agree to equal cake portions if mine accounts for the baking time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's a bigger portion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only before labour is included in the calculation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate the spare icing already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Research and development. Please keep the categories separate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. One game.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And whose cleaning method we use all year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not what I agreed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's ask the whole club to witness the clarification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's just a snack.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's also our first impression of the new committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They won't care.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside the plate so we can test that publicly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carry the table with me, not for me. I'd like us to be partners today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can do it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the arrangement I'm trying to stop calling our friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Take the other end.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Now ask where we're putting it instead of deciding for both ends.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me write the complaint as a colleague, not my parent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was only correcting your spelling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave the angry sentence. That's my contribution.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quite a good sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put both our names under it, not 'on behalf of.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's cold now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What were you waiting for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A goodbye that doesn't sound like you're already somewhere else. Have another sip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't go yet. You came to return the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I thought putting it down would take longer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need it back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I needed to see whether you'd sit down before giving it up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So we're okay?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was embarrassed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I put one extra chair in the hall?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then welcome to our first agenda item: what your chair authorises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can a couple of relatives come for tea?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, that's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. They're bringing the cousins who introduced them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many people is this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It starts with the approved couple. The rest is family context.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's not the same job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember volunteering to finish the last detail of the fete?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The banner, yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The banner announces a raffle nobody has organised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to paint words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And 'raffle' is the word still needing the most work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coats don't drink tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're asking who visited.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We ate late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sure. Where do we start?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With the records proving we should replace the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking again, now you can see what we've been storing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Join my campaign to save the club garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Absolutely. Who threatens it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our extension plan. The one we both signed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're campaigning against ourselves?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We know the opposition's weaknesses. Will you join the honest version?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't decided to bid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like deciding backwards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember my suggestion to put the spare key under the flowerpot?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I called it unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now we're locked out beside a very useful flowerpot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Good idea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say whose idea while you lift it. The pot can't accept all the credit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That strip of tape I added is holding the whole stage curtain up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought it looked untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Untidiness has just saved the finale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank the stage crew.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the person you asked to remove the tape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant a quiet evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And returning it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign up for the overnight shift if this project matters to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you signed up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm keeping myself available for leadership decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: At three in the morning?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apparently my test has reached a less comfortable definition of commitment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean watching comfortably.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can I keep one plant on your windowsill?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One small plant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Sunlight is available to guests. Shall we discuss the other pot?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've agreed the principle. Now we're negotiating the size of its audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit that I helped with one paragraph of the speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The opening paragraph, yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The paragraph that establishes the argument for the rest?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Don't claim the whole speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only following the opening wherever you took it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember the decorative ribbon? That's where the whole tent problem began.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tied it to the support rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but nobody questioned why the ribbon was there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you pulled the rope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Following the ribbon's invitation. We should review decorative influences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That innocent cup started the argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tipped it onto my letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A badly positioned cup creates difficult choices.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which shows how far the cup had already entered the situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you driving too fast?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What changed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What happened to the building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your garden gnome is coming home in a different arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What arrangement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Several pieces, carefully packed. I wanted you to hear 'coming home' first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is it broken?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Most pieces are here, and we can start with the smile.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the time?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you tell me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hid the first complaint letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've admitted hiding a letter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I'm not asking you to stand in the spotlight alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There was a third one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's put our envelopes down in order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The collapsed cake was foreshadowed by that first wobble.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored the wobble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I allowed the audience to discover its significance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There is no cake now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The empty stand pays off the warning beautifully.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're standing in the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You meant conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Water is now the dominant topic. A remarkably accurate forecast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said we'd need to open up. The plumbing listened first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote 'pack sunscreen.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a speed contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A narrow category. How many wildflowers did you notice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I noticed the finish line.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I also win for variety of attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The small trophy is better. It shows restraint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. How gracefully can your enormous cup fit in a cupboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine says first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And mine doesn't need to shout. Another victory in modesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The roof needs replacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It may cost our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We said the concert would bring the village together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The power's out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You always forget to eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they'll keep you well as long as you choose to stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds very final.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only because I want the last thing you hear here to be kindness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. That gets the car moving, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow the dress for ten pounds and an acknowledgment that you mocked it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's twenty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Money covers fabric. It doesn't cover wearing my bad taste proudly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. It's beautiful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now say which part of my judgement improved since yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said I'd carry one box. That warehouse isn't the box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help me move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With one box. We admired how manageable the sentence was.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Make it the biggest one, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. The word 'one' has retained its dignity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I agreed to watch your dog today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A separate word with no place in our agreement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you loved dogs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An enduring feeling, not a calendar extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake needed somewhere flat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's managed perfectly well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.
